title: Deep-MKV-TS: Path-Dependent McKean--Vlasov Control for Financial Time Series Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Deep-MKV-TS, a path-dependent McKean-Vlasov framework for financial scenario generation. The stochastic dynamics are chosen by matching selected path and volatility features of generated scenarios to those observed in the data. Starting from an interpretable reference model, Deep-MKV-TS preserves the reference drift and adjusts its volatility, while a regularization penalty limits unnecessary departures from the calibrated dynamics. We solve the resulting control problem using a neural, sample-based implementation of the stochastic maximum principle.   We validate the method against an exactly computable oracle. On Heston and Heston-mixture models, Deep-MKV-TS substantially reduces path-dependent and volatility-related deficiencies of the reference model. translated_title: 深度MKV-TS：用于金融时间序列生成的路径依赖麦基恩-弗拉索夫控制
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19394v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们引入了Deep-MKV-TS，一种用于金融情景生成的路径依赖麦基恩-弗拉索夫框架。随机动力学通过将生成情景的选定路径和波动率特征与数据中观察到的特征进行匹配来选择。从一个可解释的参考模型出发，Deep-MKV-TS保留参考漂移并调整其波动率，同时正则化惩罚限制了与校准动力学的非必要偏离。我们使用随机最大值原理的神经样本实现来解决所得的控制问题。我们针对一个可精确计算的基准模型验证了该方法。在Heston和Heston混合模型上，Deep-MKV-TS显著减少了参考模型的路径依赖和波动率相关缺陷。在延迟波动率实验中，随着预测范围的增加，校正仍然有效，而直接训练变得不太可靠。在保留的日内数据上，该模型也表现良好。
tldr: 本文提出Deep-MKV-TS框架，通过路径依赖麦基恩-弗拉索夫控制匹配金融时间序列的路径和波动率特征，显著提升生成情景的准确性，尤其在长预测范围内优于直接训练方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Deep-MKV-TS, a path-dependent McKean-Vlasov control framework that matches path and volatility features in financial time series generation, substantially improving accuracy, especially for longer forecasting horizons over direct training.
